create.name: Yoga Vedanta Aalst
create.bio:
Yoga Vedanta Aalst is the Aalst branch of the Divine Life Society, the movement founded in Rishikesh by Swami Sivananda, and teaches classical hatha yoga and Vedanta in his line in this East Flemish town. It is run as a non-profit association with a large team of volunteer teachers, and in 2026 it moved from its Swami Sivananda Yoga Ashram on Volksverheffingstraat into a new ashram on Geraardsbergsestraat, opened with a ceremony and satsang in September.

The weekly timetable runs from Monday to Saturday, with beginners' and advanced hatha yoga classes in the mornings, afternoons and evenings, yoga nidra once a month, a Friday meditation evening and a Saturday satsang open to all. Members also get live online classes four times a week and a library of recorded lessons. New students start after a free introductory talk and join for a yearly membership fee. Yoga Vedanta Aalst also runs its own four-year Yoga Academy, a teacher training of more than 500 hours covering asana, pranayama and meditation, the Yoga Sutras, Upanishads and Bhagavad Gita, Western anatomy and philosophy, and the art of teaching, recognised by the Flemish yoga federation and the European Yoga Union. Weekend retreats are held during the year.

courses.title: Yoga for beginners (yearly membership)
courses.description: Beginners start with a free introductory talk at the ashram and then choose a weekly class slot on a weekday morning, afternoon or evening. The yearly membership covers a year of lessons.

courses.title: Weekly timetable: classes, meditation and satsang
courses.description: The full timetable of hatha yoga classes for beginners and advanced students with each teacher, plus yoga nidra on the last Friday of the month, a Friday evening meditation and a Saturday satsang open to everyone.

courses.title: Live online yoga classes for members
courses.description: Members can follow four live online classes a week, on Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday, and use a collection of recorded audio and video lessons. Access is given by email.
